name: dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt_m5-m5-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed mtp-seqrtt-c-20ec697d1-tc (dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt, RTL 20ec697d1, snapshot of 5 drifted files): same RTL, outline 151.2x151.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:mtp-head-1010

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_pair.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_link_rtt.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/rtt/ot_dsrom_mtp_rstsync.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_skid.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_mtp_seq.sv && echo lint-ok

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
